out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: 1. Gap observed along the bottom threshold of front doors 2. Night/delivery drive through window does not automatically close
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Adjust self-closing device at window.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: Caulk in poor repair at top/left side of hood.
violations.corrective_action: Seal hood with high temperature caulk. Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty- second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage.
